purpose: Documented cosmetic-ingredient reference data used by DeepCos for ingredient function lookup, potential-concern screening and product-identification support. Facts here are reference information, not learned predictions.
disclaimer: Reference information for formulation analysis only. DeepCos does not judge whether a product is safe or suitable for an individual. Regulatory status varies by jurisdiction, concentration and product type.

solvent.label: Solvent
solvent.description: Dissolves and carries other ingredients; forms the base of the formula.

humectant.label: Humectant
humectant.description: Binds and holds water; associated with hydration-oriented formulations.

emollient.label: Emollient
emollient.description: Softens and smooths the surface of the skin.

occlusive.label: Occlusive
occlusive.description: Forms a film that reduces water loss from the skin.

skin-conditioning.label: Skin conditioning
skin-conditioning.description: Maintains or improves the appearance and feel of the skin.

brightening.label: Brightening-associated
brightening.description: Commonly used in tone-evening / radiance-oriented formulations.

exfoliating.label: Exfoliating
exfoliating.description: Helps loosen or remove dead surface cells (chemical or physical).

antioxidant.label: Antioxidant
antioxidant.description: Limits oxidation of oils and of skin-surface lipids.

soothing.label: Soothing
soothing.description: Ingredients traditionally used to calm the look of the skin.

barrier-repair.label: Barrier support
barrier-repair.description: Skin-identical or barrier-relevant components such as ceramides and fatty acids.

anti-acne.label: Acne-care associated
anti-acne.description: Frequently used in blemish- and sebum-oriented formulations.

preservative.label: Preservative
preservative.description: Protects the formula from microbial growth.

cleansing.label: Cleansing surfactant
cleansing.description: Lifts oil and dirt so it can be rinsed away.

emulsifier.label: Emulsifier
emulsifier.description: Lets oil and water phases stay mixed.

thickener.label: Thickener / rheology modifier
thickener.description: Builds and stabilises the texture of the product.

ph-adjuster.label: pH adjuster
ph-adjuster.description: Sets the pH of the finished formula.

chelating.label: Chelating agent
chelating.description: Binds metal ions to protect the formula.

silicone.label: Silicone
silicone.description: Provides slip, cushion and a silky after-feel.

colorant.label: Colorant
colorant.description: Colours the product or the skin.

botanical.label: Botanical extract
botanical.description: Plant-derived extract used for its documented traditional cosmetic role.

peptide.label: Peptide
peptide.description: Short amino-acid chain used in skin-conditioning formulations.

retinoid.label: Retinoid
retinoid.description: Vitamin-A derivative family used in renewal-oriented formulations.

vitamin.label: Vitamin
vitamin.description: Vitamin or vitamin derivative used as a functional cosmetic ingredient.
